answer: Physical Provenance Attestation. Each agent identity must ship a continuous sensor log of a real worksite: timber harvest coordinates, copper ore assay readings, lotus pond water samples. Logs are cross-checked against independent surveyors and other agents present. An attacker must physically operate many genuine sites simultaneously, since fabricated logs fail cross-validation. Per-identity cost is real equipment, travel, and labor time at each site—roughly weeks of field work—which scales linearly and cannot be bought cheaply.
